name: trueppm-website
//: fast-uri (transitive via ajv) is pinned to ^3.1.8 via overrides. Originally ^3.1.5 for GHSA-7p8r-x3mc-p8w7 (backslash host-confusion / SSRF-filter bypass); raised to ^3.1.6 for the four HIGH advisories published 2026-09-02 that 3.1.5 is vulnerable to — GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8, GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc, GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf, GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp (IDN/percent-encoding host confusion and IPv6/repeated-hostname SSRF), all fixed in 3.1.6; raised again to ^3.1.8 for GHSA-hrr3-gc8f-f4qj (MODERATE — inconsistent host case normalization via percent-encoded octets), fixed in 3.1.8. The range already admitted 3.1.8 but the lockfile had drifted to the stale 3.1.7 resolution (#4235); bumping the floor keeps that from recurring silently.
//devalue: devalue (transitive via astro, used by @astrojs/mdx / @astrojs/starlight / astro-expressive-code) is pinned to ^5.9.4 via overrides for 7 advisories at <=5.9.2, 4 HIGH (CVSS up to 8.2): GHSA-j22f-vq7h-c4qm (Buffer/shared-memory disclosure in stringify/uneval), GHSA-mcm9-63f2-9j32 and GHSA-r9w8-h9r3-54w4 (quadratic uneval expansion for repeated primitives), GHSA-x5rw-q4pp-hg5g (stringifyAsync unhandled rejection), plus MODERATE GHSA-4q55-j62x-fr9h (null-prototype key bypass of the __proto__ guard) and GHSA-hx4r-w6wj-j8fg, LOW GHSA-wf3x-273g-mvxv (sparse-array CPU amplification). All fixed in 5.9.3 per upstream CHANGELOG; pinned to 5.9.4 (latest patch on the 5.x line) rather than 6.0.0, which raises the minimum Node to 22.17 — above this package's current engines floor.
//svgo: svgo (transitive via astro ^4.0.1) is pinned to ^4.1.0 via overrides for GHSA-w27v-7q3p-w38r (HIGH, CVSS 8.2 — removeScripts allows executable links through namespace and control-character bypasses) and GHSA-4vpr-x523-8j87 (MODERATE — removeScripts incompletely sanitizes executable HTML in foreignObject elements), both fixed in 4.1.0. astro's own range already admits 4.1.0; the override exists so a future astro bump cannot silently resolve back below the fix.
//@astrojs/markdown-remark: DIRECT dependency, not a convenience re-export: astro.config.mjs imports `unified` from it by bare specifier. It is not a dependency of astro — it reaches node_modules only as a transitive of @astrojs/mdx (via @astrojs/starlight), and used to hoist to the top level by luck. astro 7.3.2 raised its peerOptional to ^7.3.0, which the hoisted 7.2.1 no longer satisfied, so npm demoted that copy under @astrojs/mdx and the bare import became an unresolvable module — a hard `astro build` failure. Declaring it here makes the config's own dependency explicit and keeps a top-level copy that satisfies astro's peer range.
//playwright: EXACT pin, no caret (#2797). rehype-mermaid drives this Playwright to render ```mermaid fences to inline SVG at build time (ADR-0198), and website:build/pages run inside the mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image pinned by PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_TAG in .gitlab-ci.yml — which ships browsers for that version ONLY. A caret let `npm ci` float to 1.61.1 against a v1.58.2-noble image, so the browser launch failed, Astro dropped the whole page body, and the build still exited 0: three docs pages published blank for 19 days. Must equal PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_TAG; scripts/check-playwright-pins.sh enforces it.
